verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript library whose public API (e.g. `new THREE.WebGLRenderer(...)`, `renderer.setSize`, scene/camera/mesh construction) is documented and installable via npm. The docs, manual, examples and machine-oriented llms.txt / llms-full.txt (which include explicit LLM instructions) give agents a documented path to drive it directly. The OpenAPI 404 probe is not relevant, since this is a code library rather than an HTTP service. missing for 10: human doc pages are hash-routed with no per-page static or markdown URLs, and the community-maintained @types/three signatures reportedly don't always match the code.
